title: Doom
description: At the end of the enemy turn, if it has at least as much Doom as HP, it dies.
smart_description: At the end of the {OnPlayer:player|enemy} turn, if [gold]{OwnerName}[/gold] has [blue]{Amount}[/blue] or less HP, it dies.
notes: Multiple creatures can be doomed simultaneously. When any doomed creature's HP becomes less than or equal to their Doom stacks at the end of their turn, they and any other doomed creatures on their side die together with a special Doom VFX animation.
